name: Johannes Hagemann
bio: Johannes Hagemann is a co-founder of Prime Intellect, a company working on open and decentralized AI training. They are an author of the INTELLECT-1 technical report, covering a 10-billion-parameter model trained across several continents with the PRIME fault-tolerant framework. The run reported a roughly 400x reduction in communication bandwidth.
known_for: Author of INTELLECT-1 decentralized training report
